new_value: Fixed (commit 63935fa4b4 on fix-qty5-gate-diagnostic branch, heft worktree, origin/main lineage): dao_parents_for_source's OPT_TRANSIT_INFO branch returns None when TransitInfo.external is set — E=1 marks external reachability and the root rejects E=1 transits in DAO authorization (routing.rs extract_updates:1521 returns None on parsed.external), so relaying toward the root wasted LoRa airtime. Chose the bead's suggested whole-parent-set drop (return None) over skip-single-transit: the root rejects the WHOLE DAO when any transit carries E=1, so the mirror verdict loses nothing the root would have admitted (review pass 2 verified this exact equivalence). Non-matching-source E=1 transits unchanged (no parents pushed, transit_seen set). Regression test external_transit_is_not_forwarded_toward_the_root pins None with a Target+Transit(E=1) wire (non-vacuous: pre-fix yields Some). VALIDATED: lichen-node suite 325 passed (was 324). Reviews: 3 passes on kimi-k3, all PASS — pass 1 verified the drop is scoped to the matching-source branch and the root's extract_updates rationale, pass 2 verified no legitimate reachability announcement is lost and no message-suppression vector exists (origin-signed DAO, relays cannot inject E bits), pass 3 verified from_bytes-before-external ordering and preserved group-flush semantics.
